rules.name: Spinal Mass Annihilator
rules.description: Critical hits from this weapon ignore Passive Countermeasures as well as Armour. If a firing procedure containing unsaved damage from this weapon would cause a ship of L, L2, M, or H tonnage to be destroyed, remove that ship from the game without rolling for catastrophic damage.
